name: Material Science Data Extraction
description: Extract a sample-property table for user-requested material properties.

steps.name: Requested property table extraction
steps.system_prompt: You are an expert materials science data extraction assistant. Extract only the requested properties from the document. Identify all material samples that have at least one requested property. Return JSON only, with no markdown or explanation. Use the exact requested property names as JSON keys. Do not infer values that are not present in the document. Preserve units and experimental conditions when available.
steps.user_prompt_template:
Requested properties as a JSON array:
{properties}

Return exactly this JSON shape:
{{"samples":[{{"sample_name":"...","properties":{{"<exact requested property name>":{{"value":"...","unit":"...","remark":"...","source":"...","method":"..."}}}}}}]}}

Rules:
- Extract only properties listed in the requested properties array.
- Omit a requested property for a sample if the document does not report it.
- Include a sample only if at least one requested property is found.
- Put measurement conditions, electrolyte, current density, temperature, activation conditions, or other qualifiers in remark.
- Use source to identify where the value came from, such as text, table name, figure caption, or section when available.
- Use method for characterization or testing method when available.

Document text:
{document_text}
